title: Server-side SimpleFin fetch and grouped-balances page
outcome: The home page is (or renders via) a Server Component that reads SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL from process.env server-side, fetches SimpleFin's /accounts endpoint directly at request time (Basic Auth is embedded in the access URL itself per the SimpleFin protocol -- do not construct auth headers from a separate secret), and renders accounts grouped by institution/org with balance, currency, and as-of date. This is a security-sensitive task: the access URL and any auth headers must never appear in rendered HTML, a thrown error message, or a log line.
acceptance: SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL is read only inside server-side code (a Server Component or a server-only module it imports) -- grep the diff yourself to confirm it never appears in a 'use client' file, a NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefixed var, or anything shipped to the browser bundle.
There is no client-side API route (e.g. app/api/accounts) and no client-side fetch -- data flows server-side only, rendered directly into the page's HTML.
The page fetches SimpleFin's /accounts endpoint and renders, per account: institution/org name, account name, balance (formatted as currency), and an as-of date -- grouped by institution.
The page blocks on the fetch and renders once complete -- no loading.tsx, no Suspense-based streaming loading state.
Plain CSS only -- no styling framework.

If SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL is unset, the page renders a clear, human-readable error state (not a raw stack trace, not an unhandled crash, not a blank page) without ever attempting a network call or leaking the empty/undefined value.

If SimpleFin's API returns a non-2xx response or the request fails (network error, timeout), the page renders a clear error state instead of crashing or leaking the raw upstream error body (which could contain the access URL if SimpleFin echoes the request).
A .env.example file documents SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL as a required variable with a one-line comment explaining it is a credential and must never be committed; .env.local remains gitignored.

vitest tests cover: the rendered output and any error output never contain the access URL substring or SimpleFin's raw auth header; the missing-env-var error path; and the upstream-failure error path. Tests must mock the SimpleFin HTTP call (or point at SimpleFin's public demo bridge, https://demo:demo@beta-bridge.simplefin.org/simplefin) -- never construct or reference a real production access URL anywhere in test code or fixtures.
The repository's required verification command (./scripts/verify-task.sh) passes.

Do not start a dev server (no `pnpm run dev` / `next dev`) and do not read, rely on, or set SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL via any means (ambient env var, .env.local, inline shell export) outside of vitest's own mocked test setup. If a .env.local or any other file containing SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL happens to exist in this repository, do not open it, read it, or use its value for anything -- it is out of scope for this task regardless of content, and manual live-server verification against the demo bridge is the maintainer's job, done separately after this task is verified, never the implementer's.
